title: Bauxite Grinding Mill
model_title: Bauxite Ball Mill (Wet Grinding in Spent Liquor, Overflow Discharge)

introduction.definition: A ball mill grinds bauxite wet in spent caustic liquor. The rotating shell lifts steel balls that cascade onto the charge, crushing and abrading the bauxite into a fine slurry. Grinding exposes the alumina minerals so they dissolve quickly in digestion.
key_points: Grinding in spent liquor starts dissolution

pressure.title: Critical speed and grinding action
pressure.description: The mill turns at about 65–78 % of critical speed (n_c = 42.3/√D rpm). Balls are lifted up the rising side and cascade/cataract back onto the toe of the charge, breaking bauxite by impact and attrition. Grinding in spent liquor starts the dissolution of gibbsite and produces slurry for digestion; product size is controlled by classification (screens/cyclones).

video_tutorials.title: Bauxite Grinding Mill — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Bauxite Grinding Mill.
A ball mill grinds bauxite wet in spent caustic liquor.
The rotating shell lifts steel balls that cascade onto the charge, crushing and abrading the bauxite into a fine slurry.
Grinding exposes the alumina minerals so they dissolve quickly in digestion.
Typical applications include bauxite grinding in Bayer refineries; wet grinding of ores.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Mill: Shell with Liners / Lifters (rotates), Mill: Riding Tyres & Girth Gear (turn with the shell), Feed & Discharge Heads with Hollow Trunnions.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Bauxite Grinding Mill — Operation

script.narration: How the Bauxite Grinding Mill works.
Bauxite and liquor enter through the feed trunnion.
The shell rotates, driven through the girth gear.
Balls cascade and break the bauxite.
Slurry overflows through the discharge trunnion.
Bearings carry the mill.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
The mill turns at about 65–78 % of critical speed (n_c = 42.3/√D rpm).

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Bauxite Grinding Mill.
Monitor power, bearing temperatures, noise.
Ball top-up; liner inspection.
Reline; gear inspection.
Watch for overload/overfilling: power drop, noise change. Common cause: too much feed.
Watch for liner/bolt failure: leaks, noise. Common cause: wear, impact.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
